structured_output.rationale: All four lines carry OA-18. The claim was adjudicated (CLP07 = 2623576767957). This is a false duplicate; the fix is a MAC clerical-error reopening to add modifier 76 to lines 3 and 4. Frequency 7 not accepted on Part B.

root_cause.explanation: Lines 3 and 4 repeat the same HCPCS/modifier combination as lines 1 and 2 on the same DOS without modifier 76 distinguishing them as repeat procedures. Payer matched provider/member/DOS/procedure and denied all four.
